seoTitle: AWS ALB and ELB Access Log Parser: Latency and 5xx
metaDescription: Parse Application and Classic load balancer logs. See ELB and target status codes, latency percentiles and requests with no target. Free.
intro: Reads ALB and Classic ELB access logs and summarises status codes, processing time and errors.
why:
Load balancer logs separate the balancer status from the target status, which is the key to telling a 502 from the balancer apart from a 500 from the app.

The tool reads the quoted request, user agent and other fields correctly. A processing time of -1 means the balancer did not get a response from a target, and the summary counts those.
howTo: Download log files from S3 and unpack them, or drop the .gz files.
Filter by ELB status if needed.
Read status, latency and slowest paths.
Switch to the table for details.

faq.a: The balancer could not dispatch the request to a target or got no response in time.
The first 36 fields of the ALB format; later fields are ignored.

faq.q: What if some lines do not match?
faq.a: They are skipped and the result says how many. Network and Gateway load balancer logs use other formats.
No. Parsing happens in your browser and nothing is sent. Logs can hold IP addresses and tokens, so the page does not write them into the address bar.
